message.text:
q05.

**8 services: AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, InstanceService, MemoService, ShortcutService, UserService**

Each is declared in its own file under `proto/api/v1/`:

| Service | File |
|---|---|
| `AIService` | `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` |
| `AttachmentService` | `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto` |
| `AuthService` | `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` |
| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` |
| `UserService` | `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto` |

Note that the service name doesn't always match the filename — `idp_service.proto` defines `IdentityProviderService`. The tenth file in the directory, `common.proto`, holds only shared message types and no service, and `README.md` is documentation.

This count is confirmed by the generated code: `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/` contains exactly eight `*.connect.go` files, one per service, each with a corresponding `<Name>ServiceHandler` interface.
